Goa Rehabilitation Board is inviting applications for multiple regular posts at Patto Plaza, Panaji-Goa.

Available positions include Driver (LMV), Technician, Draughtsman, Supervisor, Junior Engineer (Electrical/Civil), Assistant Engineer (Civil), Architect, Multi-Tasking Staff and Lower Division Clerk.

Approx. gross salary ranges from ₹32,000 to ₹80,000 per month, depending on the post.

For complete details, comment “GRB” below and we’ll share the information with you.
